title: 第1章 说好的完美开局网瘾大师姐什么鬼第2章 全宗门的梦中情人是我的试药工具人
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
青云宗，外事堂。
今天，是青云宗每月一度的修行资源发放日。
数百名弟子排着长龙，等待着执事弟子分发下这个月的月例。
“那不是丹鼎峰新收的那位亲传弟子吗，他竟然已经练气三层了？”
“嘶，据说他身负先天丹体，天生就是炼丹的奇才，刚入门就被丹鼎峰主抢去当宝贝了。”
“可不是嘛！入门不过三月，引气入体，直冲炼气三层，这速度……真是人比人气死人啊。”
李玄站在队伍中，板着脸，不和任何人交流。
有人想来结交，却被他冷着的脸色，拒之千里之外。
“这开局……真不错啊。”
李玄表面不动声色，心中却是松了口气。
还好，第一次出门，没被看出来异样。
他是个穿越者。
不久前，他一觉醒来，就发现自己成了这个仙侠世界里同名同姓的少年。
开局就是青云宗丹鼎峰的亲传弟子，还附赠一个先天丹体。
这天胡开局，李玄做梦都能笑醒。
突然，原本喧闹的人群，瞬间安静下来。
人群不自觉地向两侧退开，为来者让出一条通路。
李玄好奇地顺着众人的目光望去。
只见一位女子踏着晨光而来。
她身着一袭月白色的宗门长裙，裙摆随着莲步微动，不染一丝尘埃。

三千青丝仅用一根简单的玉簪束起，垂至腰际。
她美得不似凡人，肌肤胜雪，眉眼如画，特别是那双眸子，清冷如寒潭，仿佛不为任何事物所动。
整个人如同一座行走的冰山，散发着一股生人勿近的凛冽气息。
“是……是大师姐！”
“天呐，是冷月涵大师姐！”
“她怎么会来外事堂？”
周围响起一片倒吸冷气的声音，所有人的眼神中都充满了敬畏。
冷月涵，整个青云宗的大师姐，宗主的亲传弟子。
年仅十八，便已是练气大圆满，距离筑基仅一步之遥，在整个青云宗年轻一代中，位列前三！
她，是所有弟子仰望追逐的目标，真正的天之骄女！
李玄心中一凛。
只见冷月涵穿过人群，并未像其他人一样去领取月例，而是径直停下，目光在人群中扫过。
当她的视线落在李玄身上时，那双古井无波的冰冷眸子里，竟闪过一丝亮光。
“李玄师弟，你原来在这里啊。”
李玄心脏猛地漏跳了一拍。
这个大师姐，和原主有关系？
问题是……
content_en:
Qingyun Sect, Foreign Affairs Hall.
Today is the Qingyun Sect’s monthly practice resource distribution day.
Hundreds of disciples lined up in a long queue, waiting for the deacon disciples to distribute this month's monthly articles.
"Isn't that the new direct disciple of Danding Peak? He has already reached the third level of Qi training?"
"Hiss, it is said that he possesses an innate alchemy body and is a born prodigy in alchemy. He was snatched away as a treasure by the Alchemy Peak Master as soon as he started."
"Isn't that right! It takes only three months to get started, to introduce Qi into the body, and to go straight to the third level of Qi refining. This speed...it's really infuriating to compare people to each other."
Li Xuan stood in the team with a straight face and did not communicate with anyone.
Someone wanted to come and make friends, but was turned away thousands of miles away by his cold face.
"This is a really good start..."
Li Xuan remained calm on the surface, but he was relieved in his heart.
Fortunately, it was my first time out and no one noticed anything strange.
He is a time traveler.
Not long ago, when he woke up, he found that he had become a boy with the same name in this fairy world.
At the beginning, he is a direct disciple of Qingyun Sect's Danding Peak, and he also comes with an innate elixir body.
On this day, Hu Kai started, and Li Xuan could wake up from his dream with a smile.
Suddenly, the originally noisy crowd suddenly became quiet.
The crowd unconsciously moved to both sides to make way for those who came.
Li Xuan followed everyone's gazes curiously.
I saw a woman coming in the morning light.
She was wearing a moon-white sect dress, and the hem of the skirt moved slightly with the lotus steps, not stained by a trace of dust.
Three thousand green silk threads are tied up with only a simple jade hairpin and hang down to her waist.
She was as beautiful as a mortal, her skin was better than snow, her features were picturesque, especially her eyes, which were as cold as a cold pool, as if they were unmoved by anything.
The whole person is like a walking iceberg, exuding a cold aura that no stranger should approach.
"Yes...it's Senior Sister!"
"Oh my god, it's Senior Sister Leng Yuehan!"
"Why did she come to the Foreign Affairs Hall?"
There was a gasp of air around them, and everyone's eyes were filled with awe.
Leng Yuehan, the senior sister of the entire Qingyun Sect and the direct disciple of the sect leader.
At only eighteen years old, he has already reached the Great Perfection of Qi training and is only one step away from foundation building. He ranks among the top three among the entire young generation of Qingyun Sect!
She is the target that all the disciples look up to and pursue, the true proud daughter of heaven!
Li Xuan's heart trembled.
Leng Yuehan was seen walking through the crowd. Instead of going to collect the monthly certificate like others, he stopped and scanned the crowd with his eyes.
When her eyes fell on Li Xuan, a glimmer of light flashed in those cold eyes.
"Junior Brother Li Xuan, you are here."
Li Xuan's heart skipped a beat.
Is this senior sister related to the original owner?
The problem is...
